format_version: 1
type_name lib.Error :: enum {None, Bad}
type_name lib.Handle :: int
type_name lib.Shape :: union {lib.Vec, f32}
type_name lib.Vec :: struct {x: f32, y: f32}
constant lib.MAX :: untyped integer
procedure lib.lookup :: proc(m: map[string][]lib.Vec, k: string) -> ([]lib.Vec, bool) #optional_ok
procedure lib.old_open :: proc(name: string) -> (lib.Handle) @(deprecated="use open")
procedure lib.open :: proc(name: string, flags: bit_set[lib.Error] = {}) -> (h: lib.Handle, err: lib.Error) @(require_results)
procedure lib.scale_f :: proc(f: f32, k: f32) -> (f32)
procedure lib.scale_vec :: proc(v: ^lib.Vec, k: f32)
procedure lib.sum :: proc(..xs: []int) -> (int)
proc_group lib.scale :: proc{scale_f, scale_vec}
